name: Off-Road Motorcycle
description: A motorcycle designed exclusively for off-road use by one rider, with no more than two wheels on the ground, such as an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria. Defined by Code of Virginia §46.2-100.
restrictions: Designed exclusively for off-road use, for one rider, with no more than two wheels on the ground; no limit on motor power or speed
Not registered and gets no plates; a new one needs a title only if it has a gasoline or diesel engine over 50 cc, so an electric one may be titled but needn't be
Can't be ridden on public roads unless converted for road use, certified to federal motor vehicle safety standards, and titled and registered as a motorcycle
